regime_context: The detector shows a single dominant, crowded leader (Oil & Gas Producers, XEG.TO) with high breadth and durability but a narrowing eligible universe (7/16 themes) and no one-narrative regime. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown avoidance), and the 0.316 directional accuracy on 117 prior calls argues for low conviction across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (XGD.TO) can build genuine trend eligibility — currently rank 2 but eligibility=false with durability 0.16 and zero breadth. The condition that retires this watch: XGD.TO crosses to eligible=true with durability_bar above 0.50 and breadth above 0.60, confirming the initial pop is becoming a real trend rather than a false challenger to Oil & Gas.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the clear leader with the highest score, highest durability bar (0.72), broadest participation (breadth 0.929), and is trend-gate eligible. The honest read is that this theme is where leadership is concentrating and the trend discipline says it has staying power — but the crowding flag (z=1.2) is a size-down caution, not a reason to chase.
evidence: trend-gate validated as risk control on this market (gate_helps=true)
crowding_z=1.2 → crowded=true, a sizing caution only
theses.dissent: Crowded energy leadership with an unscheduled-surprise share of 1.0 in the macro backdrop means a single geopolitics/oil-supply headline could violently reverse the theme, and rank-1 momentum has no forward return edge (rank-IC ~0).

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX composite by 6% or more over a rolling 20-day window while remaining trend-gate eligible

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is trend-gate eligible, has a 'trend' hurst tag (the healthiest tag for trend-following), decent durability (0.66) and breadth (0.571), and is uncrowded (z=0.4). Among eligible non-leader themes, this is the cleanest trend-continuation setup — a diversifier to the energy leader rather than a challenge to it.
evidence: narrowing rotation (eligible frac=0.44) favors established eligible trends
theses.dissent: Financials in Canada are rate-sensitive and the macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics — if inflation re-accelerates and rate-cut expectations reverse, banks could lag commodities materially.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX composite by 5% or more over a rolling 30-day window while XEG.TO continues to lead

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: XGD.TO is the nominal challenger (rank 2, score 0.672) but is NOT trend-gate eligible (eligible=false) with a very low durability bar (0.16) and zero breadth (0.0). It looks like an initial price pop without trend confirmation — the absolute-trend gate, the one validated edge, explicitly says to avoid it right now.
evidence: absolute-trend gate is the validated risk-control leg
theses.dissent: Gold miners historically benefit from geopolitical risk spikes, and with unscheduled_share=1.0 in the macro backdrop, a single event could flip this into a strong trend very quickly.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO becomes trend-gate eligible with durability bar above 0.5 and breadth above 0.6 before the watch window closes

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
